critical_code_review_comments: GesprekkenPage.js is ~1340 lines — consider splitting handleSend into a hook (chatActions) to keep file <700 lines per code-review guideline.

HelpBark fetches /api/help/for-viewer with `${userId}` template literal — when userId is undefined the request becomes `?user_id=undefined` which silently degrades to 10 anonymous topics instead of 22. Defensive guard recommended: skip fetch until userId is defined, or pass no user_id param when undefined.

Send-button click via Playwright requires Enter-press in some viewports due to 'Made with Emergent' badge overlap on bottom-right at 1280x900 — cosmetic, not functional. Consider z-index check on emergent badge in dev preview.
